valor: One thousand and eighteen hand-made drawings in pencil, crayon, pastel, paint, marker and paper bring the universe of Mucho Gusto to life. Through colors, textures, dance, animals, nature, fire and magic, Magallanes' music video seeks to bring a more human, tactile and intimate experience back to the screen.
